name: Petyr Baelish
life: Orthodontist with his own practice, high income. Manages his own money across a brokerage, a rollover IRA and a Roth. Spreadsheet person.
aesthetic: Wants precise numbers and tables he can trust. Fine with density if it's organized. Hates rounding that hides dollars.
strategy: Monthly taxable contributions split across VTI/VXUS/QQQ; harvests losses at 10% using substitute ETFs (VTI→ITOT, VXUS→IXUS, QQQ→QQQM); bonds in the IRA, growth in the Roth.
